name: Counterclockwise rotation

provenance.cv: Observed image-space candidates; weak normalized activity and early quiet-wheel priors, without metric calibration. Camera motion contaminates these cues. Original validity and failures preserved
provenance.trajectory: Estimated conditional on assumptions; no calibrated video-to-ground pose residual
provenance.uncertainty: Range across plausible alternatives, not a confidence interval

coordinate_system: Local UTM 17N east/north offset in metres. Heading and direction measured counterclockwise from east.
uncertainty: Alternative ranges have no statistical coverage claim. Position also has approximately 1.3 m map-registration sensitivity. Angular ranges may cross the wrap boundary.
